# Undesigned states

States and assets built from existing components/tokens because no design render or product
decision covers them yet. Logged here per `CLAUDE.md` for founder review — not silently shipped as
if they were verified design values.

On 3h-2 the forward address is set at body size in the mono face on two lines, the crew's part and "@domain" (the render's short address fits one line; a staging or long crew address does not), with COPY beside it when both fit and under it otherwise, and a tap on the address copies too. "Or type it in by hand" under the address opens the form with nothing read first; a booking deleted on this phone leaves the wallet at once, while its delete is still on its way to the server. |

Once a name and note are typed, the trip's guide (sticker and voice line) reads the note and offers "Use {tags}", which picks those chips; nothing is applied until tapped, and an unreachable api shows no suggestion. A signed-out inviter sees "Save your pass first" with "Save my pass". Taste chips use the onboarding taste words. |

| Screen / asset | State | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| App icon "HOME SET" (`packages/critter-bake/src/templates/app-icons.ts`) | Earned icon character mapping | `docs/product-decisions.md`'s "Live guides" line names Tokek/Pon/Lundi/Ajo/Sardi/Paco; none is "home"-themed, and no other doc gives the real "HOME SET" criteria. Placeholder: Lundi (puffin) — the one guide left over once temple/golden/bali-six (Tokek), pon (Pon) and sardi (Sardi) are assigned to their confirmed matches. Founder to confirm the real unlock criteria and character before this ships as a real earned icon. |
| App icon "BALI SIX" (`packages/critter-bake/src/templates/app-icons.ts`) | Earned icon character mapping | Reads as a Bali milestone (Tokek is Bali's guide per `docs/product-decisions.md`), but no doc gives the actual "six" criteria or asks for a character distinct from `golden`/`temple`. Placeholder: common Tokek (gecko), "point" pose, Tokek's guide colour — distinguishable from `temple` (rare, idle) and `golden` (legendary, idle) by tier/pose only. Founder to confirm the real criteria before this ships. |
| App icon PASSPORT/STAMP chrome (`packages/critter-bake/src/templates/app-icons.ts`) | Simplified ornamental detail | `design/App Icon.dc.html`'s passport card has a vertical "PASSPORT" wordmark and two 3-dot "hand" clusters; its stamp ring is dashed. `packages/critter-art/src/share/model.ts`'s `RectNode`/`TextNode` have no dashed-border or tiny-rotated-glyph primitives, and building them just for this icon-only chrome wasn't worth extending the shared card model for. Both chrome layouts keep every other DC pixel value (card position/rotation, ring diameter, photo circle) — only these two fine details are dropped. Founder to confirm this reads correctly at 1024px/60pt before shipping; if not, the fix is extending `RectNode` with a stroke-only variant, not redrawing the icons. |
| In-app 404 (`apps/mobile/src/app/+not-found.tsx`) | Unknown route | Composed from the empty-state pattern: context guide sticker (tilt pose), h2 "This page wandered off", one voice-font line in the guide colour and a single "Go home" primary pill (`router.replace('/')`). Never shows the raw path. |
| Root error boundary (`apps/mobile/src/ui/shell/RootErrorBoundary.tsx`, exported by `app/_layout.tsx` as `ErrorBoundary`) | A route throws while rendering | Follows 3i-4's "three ways forward": bottom panel with an eyebrow, h2 "That didn't load", option cards "Go back" (only when there is history) and "Go home", and a "Try again" primary pill that re-renders the route. No error code or message is shown. |
| Guide FAB (`apps/mobile/src/ui/shell/GuideFab.tsx`) | No trip or destination context; guide/help routes not yet registered | Shows Tokek (brand default) on Tokek yellow. While the guide chat (3j-1) or Help (3k-6) route is unregistered, that action (and its screen-reader action) is absent rather than pointing at a placeholder; with neither registered the FAB is a labelled image. |
| Tab bar (`apps/mobile/src/ui/shell/TabBar.tsx`) | Largest text sizes; missing tab route | From AX1 (font scale ≥ 1.6) labels hide; iOS long-press shows the system large-content viewer, Android long-press shows the label as an island toast (no system equivalent). A tab whose area route doesn't exist yet leaves its slot empty so the FAB stays centred. Badges read "{tab}, {n} new". |
| Sheet (`apps/mobile/src/ui/sheet/Sheet.tsx`) | Scrim tap; reduced motion | A tap on the .45 scrim dismisses like ✕ (iOS sheet convention; the design names ✕, drag and Android back only). Under reduced or off motion the sheet and rise cross-fade in 200 ms and the presenter stays at full size (no .93 scale), per §5's "spatial transitions → 200 ms cross-fade". |
| Push edge-swipe (`apps/mobile/src/lib/navigation/transitions.ts`) | iOS back swipe commit point | The JS stack commits when `dx + v × impact > width / 2`; impact is set so a .55 pt/ms flick commits on a 390 pt screen, but a slow drag commits at half the width rather than the designed 110 pt. Android uses the system predictive back gesture (targetSdk 36) with the stack's pop animation, not a custom predictive preview. |
| Zoom (`apps/mobile/src/ui/transitions/SharedGrow.tsx`) | Destination never measures; source gone on back | The clone waits over the card for one `base` beat (340 ms) for the detail to report its frame, then grows to the full window. Going back when the card has scrolled away or unmounted skips the unzoom and the route's own 260 ms unfade plays, as the spec's fallback says. |
| Component library: `OfflinePill` (`apps/mobile/src/ui/states`) | Offline status pill | Design-system §7 names a `NO SIGNAL` pill but no render shows it. Built as a header-pill-sized control-grey chip with an orange dot and orange label (warning, not error: offline is calm), announced politely. |
| Component library: `OutboxList` | Offline writes queue | No render. Eyebrow "Sends when you're back", then a raised list: a drawn clock while queued, the doodle check in green once sent; each row reads "label, detail, Waiting for signal / Sent". |
| Component library: `StaleCaption` | Stale data timestamp | No render. Caption-size secondary text "Updated {relative time}" via `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` in the UI locale ("this minute" under a minute). |
| Component library: `PermissionCard` | Permission denied | No render. Built on `ActionCard`: doodle icon, what stops working as the title, the guide's benefit line, then "Open Settings" plus a secondary fallback pill so the flow never dead-ends. |
| Component library: `LockedTeaser` | Paywall-locked teaser | No render (4e family covers the offer only). Raised card with lock doodle + PASS+/BOOST status chip, the server perk line, and the feature preview dimmed to .35 and hidden from screen readers; the whole card opens the offer. |
| Component library: `LimitMeter` | Quota meter / exhausted | 4b-1 is referenced but not rendered. One cell per allowance (yellow used, pink when exhausted), "n of m used", reset caption, and an "Ask at midnight"-style secondary pill only when exhausted. |
| Component library: `PendingSync` | Pending sync item | No render. Item faded to .55 with the author's small avatar bobbing beside it; reads "{label}, sending". |
| Component library: `ConfirmSheet` | Destructive confirm body | No render. Sheet body: h2 question, pink-bulleted consequence lines, then a pink hold ring (irreversible) or destructive pill, and a Cancel link. |
| Component library: `ChecklistProgress` | AI job progress | No render. Raised card: job title, then steps with outlined (pending), yellow-ringed (active) and green-ticked (done) dots; one progressbar element announces the active step. |
| Component library: `Skeleton` | Loading skeleton + slow hint | No render. `tex.hatch` blocks in card/list/photo/lines presets; after 2 s the caller's slow hint (guide line "Pon's on it") appears below. |
| Component library: `EmptyState` | Empty list | No render. Centred guide sticker (sleep pose), h3 title, the guide's voice-font line and one primary pill. |
| Component library: `ErrorSheet` | Generic "three ways forward" error body | Follows 3i-4: eyebrow, h1, ✓/✕ fact lines, alternative-path tiles, primary pill; adds a "Go back" tertiary link as the third way when a screen has no alternative tiles. |
| Component library: `PassportCover` ink variant | Standard (non-Pass+) passport cover | Only the gold Pass+ cover is rendered (4a-3). The standard cover reuses its layout (running title, ringed guide emblem, big word, mono foot) on `bg.sunken` with `tex.engraving` and gold foil text. |
| Component library: `ManifestCard` | Crew/room manifest | No render. Built on `PaperChrome`: numbered mono rows of name, seat/room and an optional status chip, dashed paper rules; read as one grouped label. |
| Component library: `SignatureLayer` | Signature pad | No render. Paper pad with a baseline and "Sign here"; draw with a finger, or "Sign with my name" (button and screen-reader action) sets the name in the signature hand. Clear appears once signed. |

Sunscreen."), not the guide's plan-aware remark; the temperature chip shows the high. With no plan rows the widget falls back to the day's briefing lines with their DONE and NUDGE. Empty: "Nothing on today's plan yet." (or "No trip yet…"); not signed in and out-of-date as the other widgets. |

Deadline passed with no change: "The plan stays as it was." Forecast improved: "The forecast improved. The plan stays as it was." and no options. (VI: "Chia sẻ vị trí", "Việc chia sẻ vị trí với cả nhóm sẽ dừng sau 10 phút."), actions STOP and +1 H. Worded as a location share: no help or health words on the lock screen. For the founder's review. |
| Help hub, checklists | Reader speaks the destination's language | The phrase card (and the checklist's "show them" step) is left out when the reader's app language is the phrase's language, e.g. a Vietnamese traveller in Vietnam. |
| 3a-8 Returning sign-in | Opened by the app when the session is gone but changes made on this phone are unsent | A returning start whose session the server says is gone (revoked, signed out elsewhere) used to wipe the phone, losing anything still queued (an expense or a message made offline). The phone now keeps its data, stops syncing and opens the existing "I have an account" page, unchanged, so the person can sign back in to that account; the kept changes upload after the restart. No copy says why the page opened. A friendlier option for the founder to choose: a Home card built from existing components ("You're signed out. Sign in to send 2 changes." with a SIGN IN button leading to this page) instead of opening the page directly. Signing in to a different account from here still loses the kept changes on the next start. |
| 3c-10 Add a must-do | Keep row first (a change from the render's order) | The render draws two places above "Keep it just as you typed it". On a phone, places that landed while the traveller reached for the keep row pushed it down, and the tap picked a place instead: an e2e run saw the typed "Fushimi Inari at sunrise" saved as the place "Sunrise". No layout with places above that row stays still while results arrive, because rows vary in height. So the keep row now sits right under the field, with the guide's places, the offline note, the no-match line and the closed section below it. The no-match line no longer says "below": "No place matches that in {place}. Keep it in your own words." For the founder's review. |
